description: Replay one exact strategy across two to eight explicit history, capital, fee, and slippage scenarios using one shared price dataset. This bounded diagnostic never changes strategy code and never signs, funds, deploys, or trades.

idempotency_key.description: Required stable retry key. Reuse it after any timeout.

market.description: One canonical instrument shared by every scenario.

min_trades.description: Minimum clean trades required in every scenario before robustness can pass. Incomplete history, unreplayed live-only inputs, degraded or short execution, or any non-positive scenario also force robust:false.

scenarios.description: Two to eight bounded scenarios on the same immutable dataset end.

bars.description: Trailing aligned bars used by this scenario.

capital.description: Fresh starting capital for this scenario.

fee_bps_per_side.description: Execution fee applied to every simulated fill.

slippage_bps_per_side.description: Adverse movement applied to every simulated fill.

strategy_id.description: Owned strategy UUID returned by generate_strategy.

name: backtest_sensitivity
